content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments represent a decentralized approach to digital transactions that bypass traditional financial systems. This is particularly significant for creators unable to utilize mainstream platforms. By adopting Solana's blockchain technology, you can facilitate payments directly in cryptocurrency, allowing you to retain more of your sales revenue. For instance, while Gumroad takes a 10% cut on sales, NOWPayments only charges a 0.5% fee, which can lead to substantial savings for your business. This difference in fees could retain $921 at just 100 sales a month on a $97 product, enhancing your profitability.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture behind Solana payments relies on a combination of decentralized networks and smart contracts. When a customer makes a purchase, their payment is processed through the Solana blockchain, allowing for fast and secure transactions. The integration with NOWPayments enables automatic conversion of various cryptocurrencies into your chosen currency, simplifying the payment process for both you and your customers. This architecture not only ensures that you have complete control over your sales but also minimizes the risk of payment failures often associated with traditional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators who find themselves locked out of conventional payment systems. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets like fonts and templates, Solana payments provide a straightforward solution that empowers you to take charge of your commerce. It is particularly relevant for creators in countries where access to Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms is restricted. By using this system, you not only gain access to a broader market but also ensure that you keep more of your hard-earned revenue.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, keeping more money in your pocket.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of Solana payments hinges on several key components, including NOWPayments for payment processing and a structured delivery method for your digital products. Leveraging tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate product delivery once the payment is confirmed, ensuring a seamless customer experience. Additionally, using a secure storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 allows you to maintain control over your digital assets. Together, these elements create a robust framework that not only facilitates transactions but also enhances your overall business architecture.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with Solana payments, first, choose a digital commerce stack that aligns with your needs—consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for a comprehensive solution. Next, set up your payment processing through NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions. Following this, configure automated delivery for your products using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, promote your digital store to your audience, ensuring that they understand the benefits of using cryptocurrency for purchases. By following these steps, you can effectively deploy a sovereign digital commerce solution.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is entirely feasible by using a decentralized payment solution like Solana. By leveraging NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you can process payments directly, avoiding high fees associated with traditional platforms. This allows you to retain more revenue and reach customers who prefer using crypto.
Solana transactions are quick, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly.

If you're looking to sell digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to create your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by selecting the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for comprehensive access to blueprints and templates. Set up an account with NOWPayments to enable crypto transactions. Choose a delivery method using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated product delivery. Configure your digital store to showcase your offerings effectively. Promote your store and payment options to your audience to drive sales.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using a cryptocurrency payment processor like NOWPayments in conjunction with Solana. This allows you to accept payments directly in crypto without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is by utilizing a self-hosted solution with NOWPayments for payment processing. This minimizes transaction fees and gives you full control over your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by using a combination of your own website and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments, effectively bypassing platforms like Gumroad and Payhip.
What are the advantages of using Solana for payments?
Using Solana for payments offers advantages such as low transaction fees, fast processing times, and the ability to retain control over your digital assets, unlike traditional platforms.
How does NOWPayments integrate with my digital store?

NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with your digital store, allowing you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies. It provides automatic payment verification and conversion, streamlining your sales process.
You retain complete ownership of your digital assets with no platform dependencies.
